_help: Ad landing pages, one folder per path. Each page is a GENERATED copy of a source page: edit the source, then run `npm run build:ads` and commit the result. Paths are meaningful names (angle-ads-N-audience, e.g. /parents-ads-4-tuition-vs-exam/); `aliases` are older URLs (the original /ads-N/) that get an identical copy whose canonical points at the main path, so ads already running never break. To add a page, add an entry here, run the build, and point the campaign at the new URL. Ad pages are noindex and have no design-switch redirect.
